_meta.description: 角色三视图/设定稿的版面模板与提示词框架，用于生成标准化的角色设计参考图
_meta.tip: 选择一个版面模板后，配合主体动作词库和风格词库使用

items.keyword: 四分区标准设定稿（A多视图 + B服装道具 + C表情库 + D全身立绘）
items.usage: 最完整版本，覆盖全部参考需求，细黑线分栏白底排版

items.keyword: 精简三区设定稿（A多视图 + C表情库 + D全身立绘）
items.usage: 省去道具区，适合服装简单的角色

items.keyword: 战斗角色设定稿（A多视图 + B武器装备 + C动作姿态 + D全身立绘）
items.usage: B区替换为武器装备展示

items.keyword: 纯高精度多视图（正面+侧面+背面，放大展示）
items.usage: 仅多视图，追求极致细节

items.keyword: thin black border lines, clean panel divisions, pure white background, professional editorial layout, left column stacked sections, right full-height hero illustration
items.usage: 参考图式细黑线分栏版面框架词

categories.name: A区·多视图提示词
categories.tip: 多视图区域的核心提示词片段（正面+侧面+背面）

items.keyword: character design multi-view turnaround, front view / side profile / back view (rear 3/4), full body each view, consistent proportions, aligned head-to-toe, pure white background, flat studio lighting, thin black panel dividers
items.usage: 多视图标准提示词，必选

items.keyword: front view: facing camera straight, arms relaxed at sides
side profile: pure left side, nose-tip/chest-line/heel aligned vertically
back view / rear 3/4 view: showing back of head, rear costume details, hair length, any worn or carried items visible from behind
items.usage: 背面/背侧视角补充（古装/长发/披风/背负武器角色必选）

items.keyword: same character identity across all views, identical hairstyle outfit accessories
consistent height alignment, top of head and bottom of feet on same horizontal line across all views

categories.name: B区·服装道具平铺提示词
categories.tip: 服装道具平铺区域的提示词片段

items.keyword: costume flat lay design sheet, items arranged neatly with spacing, top-down orthographic view, product photography style, even lighting, pure white background, thin black panel dividers
showing: inner dress, outer robe, hair crown ornament, dangling earrings, round fan, embroidered shoes
items.usage: 古风角色道具清单示例

items.keyword: each item shown at correct proportion to body scale
intricate details visible on each piece, embroidery patterns, gemstones, fabric texture
include one circular zoom-in detail showing fabric pattern / metal ornament / material texture
items.usage: 纹样/材质 zoom-in 细节放大

categories.name: C区·表情库提示词
categories.tip: 表情网格的提示词片段

items.keyword: expression sheet grid layout (2×3), bust portrait chest-up shots, same face across all expressions, consistent costume and hairstyle, white background, even lighting
6 expressions: gentle smile (default) / neutral calm (baseline) / serious cold (combat) / bright laughing (joyful) / melancholic contemplative (inner drama) / angry determined (conflict)
9 expressions grid (3×3): add surprised/shocked, shy blushing, wounded weak
facial expression changes only in brow-eye-mouth muscles, head angle unchanged

categories.name: D区·全身立绘提示词
categories.tip: 右侧大图全身立绘的提示词片段

items.keyword: full body character illustration, dynamic elegant standing pose, complete costume with fabric folds layering flow, detailed accessories, [光影氛围]
pose: hands on hips, slight body turn, confident stance
pose: one hand touching hair gently, weight shifted, elegant posture
pose: hand resting on weapon hilt, lowered center of gravity
pose: half-turned looking back over shoulder, flowing garments caught in breeze
natural standing pose, arms at sides, weight centered, neutral relaxed

categories.name: 完整设定稿一键提示词
categories.tip: 整图一次性生成的完整提示词框架（需填充角色信息）

items.keyword: character design reference sheet, professional concept art layout, thin black border lines, clean panel divisions, pure white background -- LEFT TOP: multi-view turnaround (front/side/back) full body aligned -- LEFT MIDDLE: costume & props flat lay display with circular zoom-in detail -- LEFT BOTTOM: expression grid 2×3 (neutral/smile/surprised/serious/melancholic/eyes closed) bust portraits -- RIGHT SIDE: full body standing illustration dynamic pose pure white background slight ground shadow -- model: gpt-image-2, game concept art quality, highly detailed, [艺术风格], [画质参数]
items.usage: 完整四分区设定稿一键提示词框架

categories.name: 道具设定稿模板
categories.tip: 独立道具多视角设定稿提示词（仅用于独立承担叙事/动作/世界观功能的道具）

items.keyword: professional prop design sheet, thin black border lines, clean panel layout, pure white background, multi-view orthographic display -- LEFT TOP: front view / side view / back view / top view, consistent scale -- LEFT MIDDLE: detail callout panels for material, engraving, glowing parts, joints, damage, circular or rectangular zoom-in callouts -- LEFT BOTTOM: usage and scale reference, how the prop is held/worn/activated -- RIGHT SIDE: hero prop render at slight 3/4 angle, pure white background, light ground shadow -- model: gpt-image-2
items.usage: 独立道具多视角设定稿一键提示词框架

categories.name: 质量约束红线
categories.tip: 生成时必须遵守的一致性规则

items.keyword: 红线：多视图必须为同一角色（发型/服饰/配饰完全一致）
红线：三个视角身高对齐（头顶脚底同水平线）
红线：表情库只变面部肌肉，不改头部角度和身份特征
红线：服装道具与角色身上穿戴完全匹配，不凭空添加
红线：所有区域画风/色调/光照统一
红线：所有角色/道具资产必须纯白/干净浅色背景，不加氛围场景
红线：角色/道具设定稿必须使用 gpt-image-2 生成
红线：角色随身物归入角色设定稿B区，不单独出道具图（除非独立承担剧情/特写/状态变化/跨角色流转）
